<?php

	//load the expert table node corresponding to the current category in order to find its existing Merit value
	$result = db_query("SELECT node.nid AS nid, m.field_merits_value AS merits
	FROM {node} node
	LEFT JOIN {field_data_field_expert} x ON node.nid = x.entity_id AND (x.entity_type = 'node' AND x.deleted = '0')
	LEFT JOIN {field_data_field_category} c ON node.nid = c.entity_id AND (c.entity_type = 'node' AND c.deleted = '0')
	LEFT JOIN {field_data_field_merits} m ON node.nid = m.entity_id AND (m.entity_type = 'node' AND m.deleted = '0')
	WHERE node.type = 'user_expertise'
	AND field_expert_target_id = :uid
	AND c.field_category_tid = :cat
	", array(':uid' => $rewardee_uid, ':cat' => $classification));

	$record = $result->fetchAssoc();
	//for some users and category IDs we will have to create a new user_expertise node			
	if (empty($record)) {
		$node = new stdClass();
		$node->type = 'user_expertise';
		$node->title = 'UX-' . $rewardee_uid . '-' . $classification;
		$node->language = LANGUAGE_NONE;
		node_object_prepare($node);
		$node->uid = $rewardee_uid;

		$node->field_expert[LANGUAGE_NONE][0]['target_id'] = $rewardee_uid;
		$node->field_category[LANGUAGE_NONE][0]['tid'] = $classification;

		$old_merits = 0;
		$node->field_merits[LANGUAGE_NONE][0]['value'] = $old_merits;

		$node = node_submit($node);
		node_save($node);
		$nid = $node->nid;

	}
	else {
		$old_merits = $record['merits'];
		$nid = $record['nid'];
	}
	// @time_share is the ratio of the time reported in the work report being processed divided by the project total_time
	if ($time_share == 1) {
		$cur_merits = $old_merits + $merit_reward;
	}
	else {
		$merits2add = $time_share * $merit_reward;
		$cur_merits = $old_merits + $merits2add;
	}

	//updating the node with new merit value
	$xobject = entity_metadata_wrapper('node', $nid);
	$xobject->field_merits = $cur_merits;
	$xobject->save();
?>
